entities.summary: Seyit Ali Çabuk (1889–1939), usually called Corporal Seyit was a First World War gunner in the Ottoman Army. He is famous for having carried three shells to an artillery piece during the Allied attempt to force the Dardanelles on 18 March 1915.

entities.summary: Seyit Ali Çabuk (1889–1939), usually called Corporal Seyit was a First World War gunner in the Ottoman Army. He is famous for having carried three shells to an artillery piece during the Allied attempt to force the Dardanelles on 18 March 1915.
